observations.body: Jesus is brought to Annas, questioned about teaching and disciples, struck after answering, and sent to Caiaphas while Peter’s three denials unfold around the charcoal fire.
observations.label: Jesus questioned inside while Peter denies outside: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, peter, annas visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read John 18:13–27 as its own sentencing and mockery crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
